def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    background = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    marked = [[grid[r][c] != background for c in range(cols)] for r in range(rows)]
    fill = set()
    for r in range(rows):
        positions = [c for c in range(cols) if marked[r][c]]
        if len(positions) >= 2:
            fill.update((r, c) for c in range(positions[0], positions[-1] + 1))
    for c in range(cols):
        positions = [r for r in range(rows) if marked[r][c]]
        if len(positions) >= 2:
            fill.update((r, c) for r in range(positions[0], positions[-1] + 1))
    return [[3 if grid[r][c] == background and (r, c) in fill else grid[r][c]
             for c in range(cols)] for r in range(rows)]
